name: AcceptInvitationCard
title: Accept / decline an organization invitation
description: The landing card for an invitation link: shows the inviting organization and Accept/Decline buttons that call the Better Auth organization client (acceptInvitation / rejectInvitation), with inline errors and an onAccepted callback to redirect after joining. Use on an /accept-invite route.

i18nKeys.acceptinvitationcard__generic: You've been invited to join an organization.
